snippet.title: Dicey Bugs: Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dicey Bugs is a roguelite dice‑building creature collector where you control both sides of the fight by choosing one action at a time. Capture bugs, unlock new dice, and customize every run. Whether you’re building the perfect team or experimenting with wild strategies, every run plays out differently keeping you always in control.

➤Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438640/Dicey_Bugs/
➤Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/xWxN6CVTbP
